enquiry_lost_reason_required.name: enquiry_lost_reason_required
enquiry_lost_reason_required.value: "enquiry"."status" <> 'Lost' or ("enquiry"."lost_reason" is not null and length(trim("enquiry"."lost_reason")) > 0)

design_approval_complete.name: design_approval_complete
design_approval_complete.value: "design"."approval_status" <> 'Approved' or ("design"."approved_at" is not null and "design"."approved_by" is not null)

job_card_hold_reason_required.name: job_card_hold_reason_required
job_card_hold_reason_required.value: "job_card"."status" <> 'On Hold' or ("job_card"."hold_reason" is not null and length(trim("job_card"."hold_reason")) > 0)
